runs.text: Wind Rose is a power metal band founded in Tuscany, Italy in 2009 by singer Francesco Cavalieri, guitarist Claudio Falconcini and keyboardist Federico Meranda. Music and lyrics draw inspiration from the fantasy world of Tolkien, and in particular from the Dwarves, the fictional race that also influences the costumes and the look of the band
